analysis.title: Etsy: Clean Beat and Raise
key_insights: Etsy delivered a clean 3Q26 beat and raised the 4Q outlook. GMS rose 8.8% y/y and 9.1% FX-neutral, with FX-neutral growth accelerating ~190bps sequentially, the sixth consecutive quarter of acceleration.
Active buyers returned to y/y growth for the first time in two years and rose ~540k q/q. Habitual and repeat buyers also increased modestly sequentially.

Personalization now contributes ~2pts to annualized GMS growth. Buyer profiles power personalized feeds, recommendations and owned marketing for four out of five active buyers, and Etsy has begun extending personalization to signed-out users.
GMS per active buyer rose 3.9% y/y and accelerated sequentially. Purchase frequency remains modestly negative y/y.

Revenue grew 10.9% y/y, ahead of GMS. Take rate expanded 50bps to 26.2%, mainly from Etsy Ads and to a lesser extent Offsite Ads. Incremental take rate was ~32%, of which ~15 points came from Etsy Ads.
Etsy currently deploys only a portion of seller ad budgets, so DB sees room for ad monetization to grow through better ad efficiency rather than higher ad load.
Home & Living was strong in 3Q, particularly rugs, home décor and home improvement, alongside jewelry and vintage. This supported AOV and GMS per buyer before frequency turned positive.
Marketing expense rose y/y, but marketing-attributed GMS grew faster and ROI improved. Cost of adding new and reactivated customers is ~$16.50, up 11% y/y, which DB flags as a watch point.

Capital returns: ~$395mn of stock repurchased in 3Q, cutting shares outstanding by ~5.2mn, with $2.2bn of authorization remaining. On October 1 Etsy retired ~$650mn of the remaining 2019 convertible notes, which were in the money.
3Q adjusted EBITDA margin was 30.4% with 112% FCF conversion. The 4Q margin outlook is ~30%.
4Q GMS outlook of $3.46-3.52bn implies 5-7% y/y growth despite tougher comparisons and a modest FX headwind.
DB's 4Q26 estimates: GMS $3.51bn (+6.6% y/y, from $3.42bn previously), revenue ~$899mn (from $875mn), take rate 25.6%, adj EBITDA $268mn at 29.8% margin.

Rating stays Hold. Price target rises to $100 from $90, based on 11x FY27 EBITDA (down from 12x to reflect lower market multiples). DB wants sustained high-single-digit to double-digit GMS growth in FY27 before the stock can command a more premium multiple.

DB views AI/agentic shopping as a potential tailwind because handmade products are not widely available at mass-market merchandisers, unique items benefit from AI classification, and Etsy has no global parallel in its handmade niche. Etsy is testing onsite shopping assistants beyond its Gifting Assistant, and an AI seller assistant is in beta.

market_movers.rationale: Hold maintained, target raised to $100 from $90 on 11x FY27 EBITDA after a clean 3Q beat and higher 4Q guide. DB wants proof of sustained HSD-to-DD GMS growth in FY27 before a higher multiple.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 (reported): GMS +8.8% y/y, +9.1% FX-neutral. Revenue +10.9% y/y. Take rate 26.2%, up 50bps. Adjusted EBITDA margin 30.4%, FCF conversion 112%.
4Q26 company outlook: GMS $3.46-3.52bn (5-7% y/y), adj EBITDA margin ~30%.
4Q26 DB estimates (forecast): GMS $3.51bn (+6.6% y/y, previously $3.42bn), revenue ~$899mn (previously $875mn), take rate 25.6%, adj EBITDA $268mn at 29.8% margin.
Buybacks of ~$395mn in 3Q reduced shares outstanding by ~5.2mn, with $2.2bn authorization remaining.
risk_factors: Consumer spend is uncertain heading into the holiday season, and third-party data shows US spend growth modestly decelerating from 3Q26 levels.
Macro deterioration could create downside risk to DB's estimates.
Customer acquisition cost of ~$16.50 per new and reactivated customer, up 11% y/y.
Purchase frequency is still modestly negative y/y, and comparisons get tougher in FY27.
Upside risk to estimates if product improvements keep driving GMS.

tension_points.bull_case: 3Q26 showed broad, internally driven recovery: six straight quarters of GMS acceleration, active buyers back to y/y growth, personalization adding ~2pts to GMS growth, and take rate rising on Etsy Ads.
tension_points.bear_case: Frequency is still modestly negative y/y, new-customer acquisition cost is up 11% y/y, comparisons get tougher in FY27, and holiday consumer spend is uncertain.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Failure to sustain HSD-to-DD GMS growth in FY27 as comps get tougher would keep the stock from commanding a premium multiple.

theme_stances.key_argument: Personalization and discovery investments are translating into durable marketplace improvement and measurable GMS growth.
theme_stances.evidence: 3Q26 provided compelling evidence that Etsy's personalization and discovery investments
